title: Battery and Cables: Component Overview
introduction: The battery gets the headline, but it has a supporting cast. I use this short inventory to keep the energy store, the cable assembly with current sensing, the BJB and the battery tray in view together. It identifies system components; BJB details, cable routing, testing and removal instructions are outside this overview.

edits.text: The battery and cable system includes these components:
edits.why: Read this as a component inventory. It establishes what belongs to the system before you move to information about a particular part.
The battery stores electrical energy. The generator contributes electrical power with the engine running, so their roles are related but distinct.

edits.text: Battery cable assembly, including a battery current sensor and a generator current sensor.
edits.why: Current sensing is part of this assembly's identity. The battery current sensor measures current flowing into or out of the battery and is attached to the negative battery cable.

edits.text: BJB — included in the battery and cable system.
Battery tray — the battery's supporting tray.
